events.title: European Shares Edge Lower As Rate Worries Return To Haunt
events.description: European stocks drifted lower on Thursday as Brent crude futures held above the key $100-per-barrel level amid ongoing West Asia tensions and hawkish Federal Reserve commentary raised expectations of another Fed rate hike.

events.title: Yen Slides Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, after the U.S. business activity index was much greater than anticipated.

events.title: Asian Shares Mostly Lower On Inflation, Rate Concerns
events.description: Asian stocks retreated on Thursday, even as Japan's Nikkei rose notably as Tokyo markets reopened after a three-day holiday.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls As Unemployment Rate Rises
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, after the release of the most recent domestic labor market data.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Set To Open Lower As Investors Weigh Inflation Risks
events.description: European stocks may drift lower at open on Thursday as investors weigh inflation concerns and await key U.S. economic data this week for additional clues on the Federal Reserve's rate trajectory.

events.title: Indian Shares Tumble On Inflation Concerns
events.description: Indian shares were sharply lower in early trade on Thursday as rising oil prices and bond yields in international markets rekindled concerns about India's import bill, inflation and earnings.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, snapping a three-session winning streak, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining, financial and technology stocks partially offset by energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Thursday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as a rebound in crude oil prices and surging bond yields renewed global inflation risks and interest rate hike concerns amid uncertainty in the resolution of the Middle East conflict and the reopening of the critical Strait of Hormuz. Asian markets closed mixed on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Likely To Drift Lower As Oil And Bond Yields Rise
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Thursday after oil prices rose sharply overnight and U.S. bond yields jumped to their highest levels in nearly two decades, raising the possibility of another interest-rate hike from the Federal Reserve this year.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved higher in five straight sessions, collecting almost 50 points or 3.1 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau although it's likely to open to the downside on Thursday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Turn Lower Again On Thursday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday ended the three-day slide in which it had tumbled almost 190 points or 3 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 6,375-point plateau although it may head south again on Thursday.
